title: WIST publisher_item Entry body (WIST-3)
description: The body of a publisher_item Entry (WIST-3 section 3.3): an Item, the name of its Collection, the Catalog ID of the Catalog it is proved against and its Inclusion Proof against that Catalog. The form alone does not prove the Item against the Catalog; WIST-3 section 3.3's conditions I1 to I7 judge the Entry.

collection.description: The name of the Item's Collection, in the form of WIST-1 section 5.1.

catalog.description: The Catalog ID of the Catalog the Item is proved against.

proof.description: The Item's Inclusion Proof against the named Catalog (WIST-1 section 4.3).

index.description: The Item's position in the list, from 0.

path.description: The sibling hashes from the leaf up, each 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits.
